subject: general
question: Which of the following changes take place in plants by environmental triggers such as light, or gravity?

options.text: Change in the shape of the leaves and fruits they provide
Change in the directions that plant parts grow in
Change in the size of ovary and anther of the flower they produce
Change in the branching pattern of their roots

solution:
Source Code:

The correct answer is __**Change in the directions that plant parts grow in**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Plants exhibit a phenomenon called **tropism**, which is their growth response to environmental stimuli such as light (phototropism) and gravity (gravitropism).
 
• **Phototropism** is the growth of plant parts in the direction of light. For example, stems usually grow towards light to maximize photosynthesis.
 
• **Gravitropism** (or geotropism) is the growth of plant parts in response to gravity. Roots typically grow downward (positive gravitropism) while stems grow upward (negative gravitropism).
 
• These directional growth changes help plants optimize their exposure to essential resources like light and water, crucial for their survival and growth.
 
• Hormones such as **auxins** play a key role in regulating these growth responses by influencing cell elongation in different parts of the plant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thigmotropism**

 
 
• It is the growth response of plants to touch or physical contact with solid objects. For example, tendrils of climbing plants wrapping around a support.
 
 
 
• **Hydrotropism**
 
 
• It is the growth response of plant roots towards moisture or water. This helps in maximizing water uptake.
 
 
 
• **Auxins**
 
 
• These are plant hormones that regulate growth by promoting cell elongation, especially in response to light and gravity.
 
• Auxins are primarily produced in the shoot tips and play a crucial role in phototropism and gravitropism.
 
 
 
• **Photoperiodism**
 
 
• It is the physiological reaction of organisms to the length of day or night. In plants, it affects processes like flowering and seed germination.
 
 
 
• **Plant Hormones**
 
 
• Besides auxins, other plant hormones like gibberellins, cytokinins, ethylene, and abscisic acid also influence various growth and developmental processes.
